title: RADIANT MOTIVE NAVIGATOR • SC HEALTHY CONNECTIONS GUIDE
subtitle: South Carolina Healthy Connections 2027 guide • General information only, not legal or eligibility advice • Guidance reviewed Nov. 22, 2026. Confirm details with SCDHHS.
alert: South Carolina Healthy Connections update (Nov. 2026): SCDHHS materials state that, beginning Jan. 1, 2027, retroactive Medicaid eligibility will generally be available for up to two months before the month of application, compared with up to three months under current policy. Federal guidance describes a one-month limit for the Medicaid adult group and two months for most other groups. Phase II managed-care changes are currently targeted for July 2027 and remain subject to approvals and readiness. Separate federal D-SNP enrollment rules also begin in 2027 for certain plans affiliated with Medicaid MCOs; they do not require every dual-eligible member to change plans immediately. Use the Medicare + Medicaid pathway below to check what to ask. Review every official notice and confirm your situation with SCDHHS.
privacy: Privacy: This guide does not ask for names, Medicaid IDs, diagnoses, health details or document contents. Do not enter patient information. The website host may process standard technical information such as IP address, browser/device details and request timestamps. No patient-level analytics or clinic reporting are enabled. SCDHHS determines eligibility and deadlines.
languageNote: Some detailed content may not yet be translated. If you need language assistance, contact SCDHHS at 888-549-0820 or ask about assistance through SC Thrive at 800-726-8774.
